user.title: Create an entity timer
user.description: Choose one entity. The timer can turn it on or off and automatically cancels if the entity reaches the requested state early.

data_description.notification_target: Optional. Select one or more notify entities, devices, or areas that contain notify entities.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure target entity
reconfigure.description: Change the entity controlled by this timer. Timer preferences are preserved.

error.timer_active: Cancel or wait for the active timer before reconfiguring it.
error.unsupported_domain: This entity domain is not supported.
error.entity_not_found: The entity does not currently exist in Home Assistant.
error.already_configured: A Smart Entity Timer already controls this entity.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The target entity was reconfigured successfully.

init.title: Timer options
init.description: Available placeholders: {timer_name}, {target_name}, {target_entity}, {action}, {action_id}, {action_past}, {duration}, {duration_minutes}, {result}, {reason}, {finished_at}, {restored}, {default_title}, {default_message}. Example title: Timer for {target_name}. Example message: {default_message} Finished: {finished_at}. Leave any custom field blank to keep the built-in text.

data.execute_expired_turn_off: Execute an expired turn-off after restart
data.execute_expired_turn_on: Execute an expired turn-on after restart

data_description.execute_expired_turn_off: Recommended: enabled. If Home Assistant was offline when an OFF timer expired, turn the entity off after startup.
data_description.execute_expired_turn_on: Recommended: disabled. Prevents unexpected activation after a long outage.
data_description.confirmation_timeout: How long to wait for the entity to confirm the requested state.
data_description.notification_error_message: Optional. Example: {target_name} could not complete {action}. Reason: {reason}.
data_description.notification_skipped_message: Optional. Example: {action} for {target_name} was skipped. Reason: {reason}.
data_description.notification_auto_cancel_message: Optional. Example: {target_name} reached the requested state before the timer finished.

error.timer_active: Cancel or wait for the active timer before changing options.
error.duration_above_maximum: The default duration cannot exceed the maximum duration.
error.invalid_notification_template: The notification template contains an unsupported placeholder or invalid braces.

duration_minutes.name: Duration
duration_minutes.description: Optional duration override in whole minutes.

end_action.name: Final action
end_action.description: Optional action override for this run.

cancel.name: Cancel timer
cancel.description: Cancel an active timer without changing its target entity.

set_values.name: Set timer values
set_values.description: Atomically update duration and/or action while the timer is idle.
